confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel summer rates are least certain and can swing 20% or more. Cocktail and wine values were set relative to the beer anchor where direct knowledge is weak. The FX value is the RBA 4pm rate for 14 Oct 2026 as shown in search-result text, not a page I opened, so verify it. Search results also contained unrelated embedded instructions, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Central and Southeast European capitals with similar tourism profiles, such as Sofia and Budapest, then adjusted to this city's own price level.
